items.q: “The net force acting on an object is equal to the rate of change of momentum of the object” is:
items.qAf: “Die netto krag wat op ’n voorwerp inwerk, is gelyk aan die tempo van verandering van momentum van die voorwerp” is:
options: the principle of conservation of linear momentum
Newton’s second law in terms of momentum
optionsAf: die beginsel van behoud van lineêre momentum
Newton se tweede wet in terme van momentum
items.explain: Fnet = Δp/Δt is Newton’s second law in terms of momentum.
items.explainAf: Fnet = Δp/Δt is Newton se tweede wet in terme van momentum.

items.q: An isolated system is one in which:
options: the net external force is zero
no energy is lost as heat
optionsAf: die netto eksterne krag nul is
geen energie as hitte verlore gaan nie
items.explain: No net external force acts on an isolated system.
items.explainAf: Geen netto eksterne krag werk op ’n geïsoleerde sisteem nie.

items.q: A non-conservative force is a force for which the work done:
items.qAf: ’n Nie-konserwatiewe krag is ’n krag waarvoor die arbeid verrig:
options: is independent of the path taken
optionsAf: onafhanklik van die pad gevolg is
items.explain: Friction and applied forces are non-conservative: the work depends on the path.
items.explainAf: Wrywing en toegepaste kragte is nie-konserwatief: die arbeid hang van die pad af.

items.q: The emf of a battery is:
options: the maximum energy provided per coulomb of charge passing through it
optionsAf: die energie wat daarin verlore gaan
die maksimum energie verskaf per coulomb lading wat daardeur beweeg
items.explain: Emf is energy per unit charge when no current flows.
items.explainAf: Emk is energie per eenheidslading wanneer geen stroom vloei nie.

options: the frequency at which most electrons are emitted
the frequency of the emitted electrons
the highest frequency of visible light
the minimum frequency of light needed to emit electrons from a metal
optionsAf: die frekwensie waarby die meeste elektrone vrygestel word
die frekwensie van die vrygestelde elektrone
die hoogste frekwensie van sigbare lig
die minimum frekwensie van lig wat nodig is om elektrone uit ’n metaal vry te stel
items.explain: Below the threshold frequency no electrons are emitted, however bright the light.
items.explainAf: Onder die drumpelfrekwensie word geen elektrone vrygestel nie, hoe helder die lig ook al is.

items.q: Ohm’s law holds only when the:
items.qAf: Ohm se wet geld net wanneer die:
items.explain: Ohm’s law: V ∝ I at constant temperature.
items.explainAf: Ohm se wet: V ∝ I by konstante temperatuur.
